words.headline: Wednesday's Odd Spike: Alarms That Won't Stop Triple to 52 Calls
words.blurb: Reports of alarms that simply refused to quit hit 52, about three times the usual 17, while street sweeping complaints more than doubled to 47. No-heat calls stayed busy too at 1,387, even with a 65-degree high.
words.card_line: Somewhere an alarm is still going. Probably.

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 735 reports, with no-heat calls close behind at 432.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled the borough with 1,160 reports, far ahead of home repairs at 669.
boroughs.Manhattan: Home repairs topped the list at 562, with noise next at 419.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars dominated with 823 reports, more than double home repairs at 330.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking wars edged out street fixes, 75 reports to 61.
